tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla na med pa'i gsang gsum yon tan dpal// mi zad mdzod 'chang chos kyi baṃkra shiṃs dbyangs// snyan pos 'gro la legs pa'i lam chen ston// phrin las lhuṃn grubaṃ bla mas dge legs stsol// chu bdag ngal ba'i sdig dang sa 'dzin dbang*// bskyod pa'i thub chod las 'ga' brtsams min par// legs pa'i dpal bskyed gdams pa'i bcud kyis len// dngos dang brgyud nas sbyin mdzad kun la btud// bde gshegs yongs kyi mkhyen brtse rdzu 'phrul stobs// gar gyi nyams rtsal rdzogs pa'i keng rus su// mngon par brdzus nas las bzhi lhun grub kyi// dpal sbyin dur khrod bdag pos dge la sbyor// gsang rgyud sprin gyi gdung skyob lha dang mi// kun gyi bla na 'phyo ba'i khong rum nas// bsam kun rdzogs mdzad srung ma'i dbang po gang*// bsngags brjod tshig gis dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir// gang gi thugs rgyud legs bskul thun mong mchog /zung gis bsdus pa'i dngos grub skyes bzang gis// rang gzhan yid kyi shing rta 'gengs pa'i thabs// bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gtam gyi rgyud mangs 'khrol// de la 'dir skabs su bab pa'i gleng bar bya ba nyid ni/ gangs ldan gyi ri bo'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i yul gru chen po 'di nyid du/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lugs bzang ji snyed pa bgyi ba rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid la gdams pa'i bka' srol bab cing thugs nyams su bstar ba'i zab chos bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la gsum ste/

bsnyen pa dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ thog mar sgrub pa po bde kye la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa slar yang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi bka' yi rjes su gnang ba man ngag sgrub skor dang bcas pa legs par thob pas/ gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas ni/ gzhung las/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag gam// lha khang la sogs dben gnas su// zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir las dang po pa'i gnas ni phyi ma ste/ de'ang bla ma gong ma la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs shing rang dbang du 'du nges pa de la phyag dar la sogs pas yid 'jug par byas te/ der rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i gdan bsham 'ong bar byas pa'i mdun du/ maṇḍal mda' gang gi tshad tsam yod pa la zhal ba khod snyoms par byas/ de'i dbus su yig rnying phal cher las gru gsum bru ba sogs bshad kyang phyag len bde ba'i ched du dbus nas mtho tshad tsam gyis zlum por bskor ba'i nang du rdul tshon dkar po la sogs pas dung dkar dang 'gron bu kha sprod kyi rnam pa legs par bris pa'i steng du 'bras sam nas kyi tshom bu dbus su gcig dang*/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re ste tshom bu dgu bkod la/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du mchog rkang ngam mchog phur zhes bya ba mi rkang gi khri'u 'am/ thod skam sgal tshigs dang bcas pa'i rnam pa shing las byas pa la dkar rtsis byugs pa gsum bcings pa'i khri'u byas/ de'ang ma 'byor na man 'ji bzhag pas kyang rung*/ de'i khar ka pā la dum bu gcig pa'i nang thams cad mar gyis khyab par bskus la bzhag de'i nang du dpal bshos zhes pa gtor ma stod zur gsum ha cang mi rno ba/ smad zlum po chang bu bdun gyen du bslang ste sbyar ba la mar gyis rgyan btags pa'am/ yang na spyir 'di dag gi rigs la zlum gtor bya ba sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa dang mthun par ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yang de bzhin bzhed de/

de dag gang la mos pa re bshams pa'i mthar mdzo drel gyi sha ma gtogs pa gtso bor ri bong gi sha dang gzhan yang lug dang g.yag rgod la sogs pa'i sha sna gtsang ma dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ shing thog dang 'bru sna dang rin po che dang dar zab la sogs pa tshogs tshad bsags te phyur bur dgang ngo*// de'i khar nor bu gnyis zhes pa dung dkar dang 'gron bu bu ma che ba gnyis dang yab yum gyi sku brnyan ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi gsang ba'i rten gzhag par bya ste/ de yang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ yar ngo skar ma rgyal la ni// snga dro'i dus su brtsam par bya// zhes pas nam bya ba'i dus bstan/ rab ni rin chen lnga las bya// 'bring ni ba so rus pa las// tha ma sa la rin chen brdar// zhes pas gang la bya ba'i rgyu bstan/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// zhes pa nas/ brkyang bskum gar gyi legs par gnas// zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rnams bstan pas/ dang po ni/ lha bzo ba dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'am/ de ma byung na'ang bri ba'i yun der gso sbyong sogs la gnas pas bya ste/ sku mdog la sogs pa ni gzhung ngam mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bzhengs grub pa dang*/ yang ji skad du/ dar dkar dag la sngags bris la// bud med ma reg gser dum gnyis// de yi thugs kar gzhug par bya// zhes pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ghṛ ha rā dza sogs kyi snying po ste/ gser la sogs pas yi ge dbu can du bris pa nang du bstan la dbu nas dril ba gnyis mgo gsham ma log par de dang mnyam du gser dum re la na bza' ser pos g.yogs la sku brnyan de gnyis kyi thugs kar gzhug go /slar yang rten gyi sku sba ba'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i 'khor lo yang gzhug par bya ste/ de ni ras sam dar dkar la dri bzang ngam/ de dang mtshal bsres pa la sogs pas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/

de'i dbus su oṃ/ rtsibs brgyad la rin po che brgyad bri/ mu khyud la/ oṃ ghṛ ha rā dza ghṛ ha rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this ratna ghṛ rtsi ma mi sems sgul sgul swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas skor du 'khor bar bkod pa'i 'khor lo de yab yum gyi lto bar gzhug go /de ltar byas pa'i sku rten de la sbyang khrus dang rab gnas rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par byas la sngar gyi thod pa'i khar man 'ji la sogs pa'i stegs la brten nas bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du dar dkar gyi gdugs dbub/ de bzhin du nang gi rten ni 'bru sna tshogs la rin po che brdar ba las byas pa dang*/ phyi'i rten ni dur khrod ro ras kyi gzhi la bris pa'i sku gnyis kyang byas te/ de gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi steng la sogs par ci bder bkram/ maṇḍal gyi mdun nas brtsams te chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor gyi rim pas bshams/ dbang ldan nas me'i bar du yi dam chos skyong mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams bshams pa'i mdun du 'di nyid kyi rgyun gtor 'bul rgyu yang sngar dang 'dra bar byas pa thod pa'i mdun thad du 'ong bar bya'o// rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod ḍā ma ru me tog rnams kyang bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mtshams gcod gtor ma gtong ba/ yo byad byin gyis brlab pa/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba/ mdun bskyed mchod gtor 'bul ba/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa dang drug las/ dang po mtshams gcod gtor ma gtong ba ni/ gzhung las de nas mtshams bcad ces pa'i don ni/ phyi mtshams nang mtshams bcad pa ste mtshams g.yog pa sogs dgos nges pa lnga'am bdun tsam las mang ba mtshams 'og tu mi 'jug pa dang*/ gal te 'jug dgos kyi dogs pa yod pa dang yo byad gsar du len dgos pa sogs kyang dmigs 'og tu chud nges par bya/ khyad par du sgrub khang na bud med mi gtong ba dam tshig yin pas shin tu gces/

phyi mis mi 'jug pa'i ched du sgo rtsar tho brtan par brtsigs/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar dmigs la/ de dag bden pa'i dpang por bzhugs bzhin pa'i spyan sngar bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam gang la byed pa de'i dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar/ sngon 'gro bsang sbyangs nas brtsam ste yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog gi bar brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i ched du bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin du bgyid par 'tshal na srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig ces pas phrin las gzhol ba'i mthar muḥzhes pa dang*/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol du gshegs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsams la/ ngag tu gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i sogs brjod cing*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rdo rje gsor la dril bu drag tu dkrol ba dang bcas pas rtsa ba'i sngags brjod la gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor ro// gnyis pa yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yi dam gyi dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ gha ṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// gsum pa bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ snga ma'i rjes thogs de ma thag par/

bshags pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags nas// snying rje tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom// shū n+ya tā yis stong par bsgom// de nas bdag nyid hūm̐ las ni// he ru ka bsam zhes gsungs pas/ 'di nyid du shis pa'i yi dam ni 'khor lo bde mchog gam/ kye rdo rje/ yang na nā ro mkha' spyod de de gsum po gang rung zhig mdzad pa phyag len te/ de'i nang nas kyang sngon du bsnyen pa song ba zhig cis kyang dgos shing de dag gang ltar yang rung*/ thog mar 'khor ba las yid 'byung*/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las 'bras blang dor la sogs pa bsam pa'i sgo nas tshe 'dir snang gi khe dang grags 'dod kyi rtog pa thams cad thag bsring ba dang*/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral 'dod kyi blos kun nas bslang ste/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba yan chad kyis bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom mo// bzhi pa mdun bskyed mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs te/ bsang sbyangs nas ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyis gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ thog mar yi dam la rang rang gi gtor chog gis gtor ma dbul/ dgongs thun lta bu la gur zhal las mgon sogs chos skyong gzhan rnams la 'bul na'ang*/ 'das gtor thams cad sdebs gcig tu skabs 'dir phul na bde bar mthong*/ de rnams kyi skabs su yang sgrub pa 'di la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i gsol gdab dang phrin las zhu/ de nas sgos kyi chos skyong bskyed cing mchod gtor 'bul ba la sogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ rgyud gzhung las/ yab yum mdun du bskyed byas te// mchod bstod gtor mas mnyes byas la// gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas// zhes pa'i don ni/ dbus kyi rten gtor la dmigs te rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor ba dang bcas pas/

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pas bgegs bsangs la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan te/ oṃ stong pa nyid du bsam/ āḥthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par mos la/ slar yang ha hoḥhrī lan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs nas nor bu gnyis dang sku la dmigs te/ ngag tu/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pas nam mkha' yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ suṃ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ suṃ las thod pa'i mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po las grub pa gru bzhi pa/ mi rus kyi rkang dang rtsib rus sna tshogs kyis steng thog phubs pa/ thod skam gyi mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan cing rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ 'og tu rus pa dang sha khrag sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa/ de'i nang du paṃ padma maṇḍa la hūm̐ gi padma'i gdan sogs nas chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes pas phrin las bcol ba'i bar yar lung pa'am rje sangs rgyas rin chen la sogs pa'i gtor chog ltar bskyed cing sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba gdan dang mchod pa 'bul ba dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod dam bzhag rnams dkyus ltar byas te rten gtor ni bsnyen pa nam grol gyi bar du 'bul ba med la mdun gyi rgyun gtor ni gong gi yi dam sogs kyi skabs su byin rlabs rgyas par byas pa de nyid slar yang 'di nyid nas 'byung ba'i byin rlabs mdor bsdus pa gong bzhin gyi byin gyis brlabs nas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma la zug ste gsol bar mos la/

sngags kyi rjes su/ shrī shma sha na a dhi pa ti pi shā tsi ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas dgyes par bsam mo// arghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi thor mas nang mchod nas 'thor zhing*/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul la dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las nas/ phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod do// lnga pa bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa mdun gyi chos skyong yab yum la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dang aṃ la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkug nas bdag la stsol zhing*/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i gdon dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad par bsams la thog mar yi dam gyi snying po brgya phrag tsam gyis thog drangs te 'di nyid kyi gsang sngags ni/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza gṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ zhes bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi ste rang nyid yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ mi tshig gi bar ma chod pa'i smra bcad dam pos sngags dag par bzla ba dang*/ gong du bstan pa ltar thugs rgyud bskul ba'i dmigs pa dang ma bral bar bya ste/ mdor na sgo gsum tha mal gyi dbang du skad cig kyang ma song ba'i ngang nas bzlas na ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni nges pa ste/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ mnyam gzhag bzlas dang bsgom pa yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod// dper na skyes bu la la zhig

/skad kyi nga ros bos pa na// mngon sum du ni 'ong bar 'gyur// de bzhin de bzhin gshegs kun gshegs// zhes gsungs la/ gzhan du na/ da lan bdag gis sgrub pa 'di bsgrubs na'ang 'grub bam mi 'grub/ bar chad 'byung ngam mi 'byung*/ dge'am mi dge snyam pa'i the tshom dang rtog ngan thams cad rgyangs bsrings te sems rtse gcig pa nyid du bya dgos kyi/ de ltar ma yin na yun ji tsam ring yang phan pa chung ste/ spyod 'jug gi bsam gtan le'ur/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yeng bar gyur pa yis// de nyid rig pa don med 'gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du gsungs pas spyir yang dge sbyor thams cad byas lo tsam min par gnad du khel ba gtso che'o// drug pa rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa ni/ de nas thun bsdu ba na/ slar yang arghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod bstod gsol gdab gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ dgongs thun lta bu la 'jig rten par gtogs pa'i srung ma gzhan la gtor ma 'bul dgos yod na 'bul/ mnga' 'gro spyi gtor ni thun thams cad kyi mjug tu byung na legs gsungs/ de rjes rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam rnams byas la/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rten rnams la brten bzhugs dang med pa rnams la oṃ khyed kyi sems can la sogs pas gshegs gsol bya/ rang gi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams gsal gdab cing bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya ste de ltar thun gcig go /de bzhin du thun gzhan rnams la mchod pa spo ba dang*/ mdun gyi gtor ma chang bus gsos/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bkra shis kyi bar la dgongs thun gyi bya ba chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo dor ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra'o// de yang thun bzhir bya ba'i nges pa ni/

sa chen gyis thun bzhir bskyed bstim bya zhes gsungs/ gal te ma lcogs pa dang sngags kyi grangs ma song gis dogs na bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir thun gsum pa nyid byas kyang chog go /de lta bu'i rim pas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs par bsgrub par bya ste sngags kyi grangs ni/ rgyud gzhung dag las/ gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas// zhes gsungs kyang rtags thon pa nyid gtso che'o// de yang ji skad du/ mgon po dngos su byon gyur na// gang 'dod dngos grub thams cad 'grub// ces bya ba la sogs pa 'grub pa'i rtags rab 'bring rnams ni gzhung yi ge rnying pa rnams las shes par bya'o// de yang rmi nyams sogs su dge ba'i ltas ji skad bstan pa re byung na dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par nges pas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom pa dang gzhan la mi smra ba'i gsang ba dam par bya'o// gal te cung zad ngan pa yang 'byung srid de/ de yang*/ nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon// zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ de dag byung na yang bden med kyi sbyong ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang chos skyong gi bskang bshags sogs la brtson par bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas bsnyen pa song nas nam zhig grol ba'i tshe na/ rten gtor chos skyong yab yum la gtang rag gi tshul du phul ba sa gtsang sar gtong ba dang*/ nor bu gnyis dang sku rten mdzod phug la sogs par mis mi mthong bar sba bar bya ste de dag gis bsnyen pa bstan zin to// da ni gnyis pa bsgrub pa bstan par bya ste/ de yang bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis 'di'i bsgrub pa bya ba la/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes gsum mo// dang po sbyor ba ni/ 'dir bsnyen pa dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod na sngar gyi maṇḍal gyi steng du zlum skor/ de'i dbus su gru gsum rtse mo phyir bstan pa mtho gang gi tshad dang ldan par bris pa'i nang du gzhi dmar po la khrag mtsho'i ri mo dang*/

dbus su dung 'gron kha sprod bris pa'i steng na nas kyi tshom bu rnams dgod pa dang*/ gru gsum gyi zur gsum du mchog phur gyi rkang pa gsum brtan par btsugs pa'i khar sngar gyi thod pa bzhag la/ de'i nang du sngar dang 'dra ba'i gtor ma mar khus sbrus pa bzang ba bshams/ de'i mtha' skor du gong du smos pa'i zas dang 'bru dang rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ khyad par rang gang dga' ba'i kha zas kyis phyur bur bkang ste bzhag go /dkyil 'khor gyi zur gsum mdun dang bzhi la 'bul gtor lag pa g.yon pa'i spar rjes dod par byas pa'i chang bu bdun re gyen du bslang ba/ de yang sbom phra ches na 'gyel ba'i nyan yod pas sbom phra cher med pa la gzer gyis bsdams pa bzhi/ phyi nas kha gso ba'i chang bu dang bcas pa shong ba'i tshad kyi snod rnams su bsham mo// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar bshad kyang ji lta ba bzhin 'grig mi thub pas dpa' bo'i ston mo'am rtsā ru'i bza' ba tsam grub na legs gsungs pas/ de'i yo byad dang sngon 'gro gtor ma'ang bsham/ gzhan sgrub rten gzhug pa dang mchod pa bsham tshul sogs ni bsnyen pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgrub pa ni/ snga thun nas mgo brtsam ste mtshams gcod pa nas bkra shis kyi bar la bsnyen pa dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par 'dir ni thun bzhir bya ba dang gtor ma 'bul tshe snga thun la mdun gyi gtor ma phul/ dgongs thun la g.yas zur gyi gtor ma/ srod thun la g.yon zur gyi gtor ma/ sang gi thor thun la rgyab kyi gtor ma rnams rim pas 'bul lo// slar yang gtor ma thams cad la chang bu bdun bdun gyis kha gso ba sogs bya'o// dbus kyi gtor ma ni byin brlab bya ba tsam ma gtogs sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du 'bul gso bya mi dgos/ de lta bu'i rim pas zhag bdun gyi bar du sgrub khang du bud med dang khyi dang dme can rnams mi gtong ba dang bsgrub rdzas rnams gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas la shin tu gsang ste bsgrub bo// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba dngos grub blang ba la sogs pa ni/

zhag brgyad pa'i snga dro'i thun gcig po de la dbus kyi gtor ma'ang kha gsos te chos skyong yab yum la 'bul lo// phul grub pa'i rjes su dbus kyi thod pa'i nang gi rang gang dga' ba'i kha zas de nyid/ chos skyong yab yum dgyes bzhin pas dngos grub tu stsal bar bsams la gzhan la mi ster bar rang nyid kyis longs spyad par bya ste de ni dngos grub blang ba zhes bya'o// 'bul gtor bzhi po'ang dbus kyi de dang dus gcig tu 'bul lo// yang tshogs sam tsā ru la sogs pa dang 'brel na de dag gi skabs su tshogs mchod kyang byas te tshogs rdzas rnams dngos grub kyi tshul du longs spyad par bya'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba rnams dang bkra shis rgyas pas mtha' brgyan pa dang bcas te rten de dag rang gi mchod khang la sogs pa'i phug tu gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas la bzhugs su gsol te nya stong tshes brgyad la sogs pa'i dus bzang rnams la mchod gtor bsngos la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab na rang la ci ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ sgrub pa thon nas bang mdzod sbas// dus bzang mchod gtor dbul bar bya// dngos grub gang 'dod gsol ba gdab// ces dang*/ sku de bang mdzod phug tu gzhug /dus bzang gsum du mchod bya ste// gsol ba btab la dngos grub blangs// thun mong rdzas dang longs spyod 'du// zhes sogs gsungs te de dag gis sgrub pa bstan zin to// da ni gsum pa las sbyor bstan par bya ste/ de'ang rgyud gzhung dag las/ sgrub pa chen po'i rtags thon nas// las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig po// bsgrubs na gang bsgrub myur du 'grub// ces gsungs pas/ gong du bstan pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i sgrub pa pos 'di'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo dang bai ro tsa na'i rgya gzhung dang sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa rnams gtso bor smos pa'i bod gzhung dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad bstan pa'i las tshogs rnams bsgrubs na rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag 'grub pa ni mi bslu ba ste/

de ni smras ma thag pa'i gzhung de rnams su shin tu gsal bas 'dir rgyas par spro bar mi bya ste/ des las tshogs mdo tsam bstan zin to// slar yang smras pa/ de lta'i rgyud gzhung dka' gnas nor bu'i khams// brgyud pa'i zhal lung pha lam rdzas sbyor gyis// drang po'i mig phug tshig gi srad bu la// tshar du dngar ba bzod pa bla ma'i drin// rgyud dang rgya bod yongs su grags pa'i gzhung*// 'gal med gong ma'i phyag len ming tshig dang*// yi ge 'dus pa'i gsal byed 'di mthong tshe// 'phyang mo nyug pa'i blo de yul gzhan bros// bstan 'gror phan pa'i skya rengs sngon 'gro mas// shes rab nam mkha'i mthongs nas bya grub kyi// bstan srung nyin mo'i mgon po dgug nus na// don gzhan zhar las 'byung ngo snying gi grogs// 'phags bod grub dbang rim par byon pa'i thugs// snying rjes yongs su bsgos las skyes pa'i bcud// gdams pa'i mchog 'di skal ldan kun gyi yid// rab dga' bskyed phyir dam pa'i mgrin par yib// rkang drug 'phur lding gsar du bsgyur ba dang*// mgrin pa'i rnga chung brdung la 'dab gshog dag /yongs su ma rdzogs nongs pa 'dab brgya'i kha// rnam par rgyas pa gang des bzod par rig /legs pa'i dge tshogs ma lus bsdoms pa'i mthus// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas// nyi 'od bran pa'i mtshams sprin gzhon nu bzhin// sa stengs snang bas khyab par brtan gyur cig /gzhan phan bsam pas kun bslangs tshul 'di la// brtson ldan su zhig rdzogs sangs rgyas yon tan// rgya mtsho bsgrub phyir ye shes spyan mnga' ba'i// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag pos skyongs gyur cig /de ltar dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ srung ma'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa dbu mdzad sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang ye shes dpal ldan chos grogs zung gis snga phyir bskul ba'i ngor/

rje sa chen gyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi yig cha gang rnyed rnams la 'dris par bltas shing*/ khyad par rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med pa 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas shing grub pa dam pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi padma gtsug gi rgyan du bsten cing man ngag dang phyag len gyi gsung sgros dri ma med pa ji ltar thos pas legs par brgyan te bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas sa pho rta'i lor sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
